newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi offers bonds worth six billion riyals.
newsitem.headline: Saudi offers bonds worth six billion riyals.

text.p: Saudi Arabia has offered two-, three- and five-year bonds worth six billion riyals to Saudi-based banks, bankers in the kingdom said on Monday.
They said the coupon for two-year bonds worth 2.5 billion riyals, maturing on April 22, 1999, was put at 6.81 percent.

The coupon for three-year bonds worth one billion riyals and maturing on April 22, 2000 was put at 7.02 percent. The coupon for five-year bonds worth 2.5 billion riyals, maturing on April 22, 2002, was put at 7.35 percent.
Bankers said the bonds' settlement would be on April 22 because of a one-week long official holiday.
